messages:
Alex (partnerships): Heads-up: CloudForge x Redwood co-webinar next Tue. Need to lock speaker order, confirm remote demo control, and final swag list. Quick sync now?
Priya (nebula): I'm free at 11am PT. On my side: Ian open with a 12min product tour, then hand off to Marco for the live hardware demo.
Olga (events): 11am PT works. I'll run AV/streaming and rehearsal checklist. Reminder: 15m tech check with speakers 45m before show.
Marco (hw-ops): Demo rack packing list posted: power strip, HDMI splitter, capture card, hot-swappable SSD with demo VM, and dongles. Shipping scheduled Fri EOD.
Eve (devrel): For fallback, Ian stream a pre-recorded run of the demo and trigger the remote notebook via temporary public endpoint. Will that satisfy the QA panel?
Priya (nebula): Yes, fallback video + live Q&A is fine. But we prefer the demo to be interactive if possible.
Ben (marketing): Swag ask: 100 branded tees (mixed S-XL), 200 stickers, 100 partner postcards. Also want a small QR card with trial code. Can logistics-bot confirm dims/weight?
logistics-bot: Shipment dims: 40x30x20 cm, weight: 12.5 kg. Pickup: Fri 10:30am. Carrier: ShipFast. Manifest: CF-RWD-2026.
Alex (partnerships): Two operational asks before EOD: 1) final slide deck uploaded to the shared drive, 2) single-line fallback blurb for the MC.
Olga (events): I'll handle MC copy. Also adding Alex and Priya to Zoom co-host list + backstage chat. Recording target: S3://redwood-recordings/cloudforge-2026/ (retention 60d).
Marco (hw-ops): Note on network: venue requires a static IP allocation; I've requested it. If NAT issues occur, fallback is to use an LTE hotspot with local demo container.
Eve (devrel): Pushing the container image to registry with tag cloudforge-demo:stable. Also adding a minimal script to switch endpoints: `export DEMO_ENDPOINT=local && ./launch.sh`
Priya (nebula): Speaker order suggestion: 1) Priya intro (12m), 2) Marco live demo (8m), 3) Alex partnership roadmap (5m), 4) Q&A (20m). Thoughts?
Ben (marketing): Good flow. For the follow-up email, I
pprove including a 30-day Redwood hosted trial promo code. Also need high-res speaker photos by EOD tomorrow.
Alex (partnerships): I'll draft the follow-up template and share. Also tagging Marco: please provide 1-2 short demo failure rehearsals we can read on-air if something goes wrong.
Marco (hw-ops): Rehearsal script snippets: 1) "If live kit is offline, we will play a recorded demo and switch to a remote sandbox"; 2) "If video/stream drops, continue with slides + live Q&A". I'll add them to runbook.
Olga (events): AV runbook snippet: 
```
- 45m before: confirm speakers in backstage chat
- 30m before: mic check for remote presenters
- 15m before: load fallback video on streaming PC
- 5m before: test stream overlay and lower-third graphics
```
Eve (devrel): Adding a short gist with sample prompts and a link to the demo notebook (sandbox mode). Will make it single-click to fork.
logistics-bot: Customs note: value declared for swag = $4 per tee, $1 per sticker to expedite clearance. Clearance service added: QuickClear.
Priya (nebula): One ask from partner: can we get a joint blog post within a week after the webinar? Wean co-author.
Ben (marketing): Absolutely. I'll draft the blog outline and loop in Priya for co-authoring. Post cadence: announce in partner newsletter + social the week after.
Alex (partnerships): Final: rehearsal schedule for Tuesday (day before) 1) full run with AV (30m), 2) presenters only dry run (15m). Olga, can you lock times?
Olga (events): Locked. Full run Monday 9am PT, presenters dry run Monday 4pm PT. Calendar invites sent.
Alex (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If there are any blockers ping here; otherwise see you at the 11am sync. :rocket:
